name: Date Kyouya
source:
One of the members of X.I.P.

The leader of X.I.P. and a ladies' man, Kyoya studied singing, acting, and dancing at an early age. Until recently, a mysterious accident stopped him from joining the entertainment industry.

Flirtatious and mature, he tends to pepper his conversations with English phrases and loves calling the protagonist a "naughty girl". Surprisingly enough, he also takes his responsibilities as leader seriously and wants nothing more than to see his group succeed.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Tokimeki_Restaurant%E2%98%86%E2%98%86%E2%98%86]Koei Wikia[/url]]
